title: Effective rank of the layer interface is the number of active keys
status: Supporting lemma (Appendix A.35). NOT a headline theorem; NOT a new ledger item.
hypothesis: Q1. Codebook C (V x V, V = 2 V_K) orthonormal, split C_key, C_val. Q2. Analytic optimum interface T* = C_key^T C_val. Q3. A dataset whose chains use at most m = n_pairs+1 DISTINCT keys in the VALUE half. Q4. Layer interface parameterized as T = U V^T / sqrt(r), U, V in R^(V x r), trained end-to-end; one learned output temperature tau > 0 (argmax invariant to tau).
claim: (a) T* has AMBIENT rank exactly V_K as a V x V matrix. (b) On the data distribution Q3, restricting T* to the span of the m active VALUE codes has rank at most m; hence a rank-r interface with r >= m can represent the restriction exactly. (c) Parameter cost is 2 V r instead of V^2, and with the fast Walsh-Hadamard transform the codebook is never materialized. (d) Empirically r < m degrades and r >= 2m is exact.
proof: Proof (a). C_key and C_val each have V_K orthonormal rows and are mutually orthogonal, so C_key^T C_val = sum_{j<V_K} e_j f_j^T with {e_j} and {f_j} orthonormal families; its rank is exactly V_K. QED. Proof (b). Only VALUE codes C[V_K + k] with k in the active key set K (|K| = m) ever appear in z_h. Let P be the orthogonal projector onto span{C[V_K+k] : k in K}. The action of T* that matters is T* P, whose image lies in span{C[k] : k in K}, dimension m; hence rank(T* P) <= m. Write T* P = sum_{i=1}^{m} sigma_i u_i v_i^T and choose U = [u_1..u_m] diag(sqrt(sigma)) sqrt(sqrt(r)), V = [v_1..v_m] diag(sqrt(sigma)) sqrt(sqrt(r)) padded with zero columns to width r >= m; then U V^T / sqrt(r) = T* P. QED. Proof (c). U and V hold 2 V r floats; the FWHT applies C in O(V log V) time and O(V) memory, so no V x V codebook is stored. At V = 2^18, V^2 = 6.87e10 entries (549.8 GB in fp64) while 2 V r with r = 8 is 4.19e6 parameters. QED. Proof (d) is empirical, NOT analytic: measured 3-seed means are r=4 -> 0.9694, r=8 -> 0.9954, r=16/24/32/48/64 -> 1.0000, with m = 5. The observed threshold lies between m and 2m; we state it as a measurement, not as a proved sharp bound on the optimization path. NON-VACUITY: V=64, V_K=32, n_pairs=4, m=5, r=32 satisfies Q1-Q4 and attains 1.0000.
boundary: SCOPE. (i) (d) is a measurement about convergence of Adam on this task, not a theorem about the minimum trainable rank; the proved statement is (b), an existence result. (ii) m depends on the DATA distribution, not on V_K; for a corpus using the whole vocabulary, m approaches V_K and the ambient bound is recovered. (iii) The temperature tau is one extra scalar and does not affect argmax; it only makes the CE loss saturate (measured final loss 0.0014 versus ~3.0 without tau). (iv) T_h is a FIXED parameter: it does not vary with t or with the input, so Toeplitz / FFT-IIR duality are preserved (measured 2.89e-16). (v) Synthetic task; no LM claim.
use: Removes the last hand-designed component of the architecture: the layer interface is learned end-to-end from a random initialization, yet five seeds reach exactly 1.0000 and the learned T aligns with T* (value->key block energy 0.9963). Together with R3, the ONLY remaining design choice is the 1-bit alphabet split, which R3 proves necessary. Gives a concrete parameter/FLOP budget at real vocabulary scale.
source: Analytic proof for (a)-(c); empirical for (d). Witnesses: results/tsc_final_rank.json, tsc_final_arms.json, tsc_final_scale.json, tsc_final_guards.json, tsc_final_gradcheck.json. Code: tools/native_probe/tsc_final_probe.py.
